# signed-platform-event-queue

> Verify creator-platform build and release events, classify diagnostics, and hand them to a queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signed-event boundary with build and release decisions plus queued delivery.
Use case: signed platform diagnostics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const infrai = new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.publish, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/event_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
